gemini_bridge.note: Current live routing is defined in state/now.json; an expired historical cooldown file does not by itself mean Gemini is blocked.

youtube_data_api.scope_limit: API-key/public-data readiness does not authorize upload, Studio, or owned analytics. Reverify before relying on account-scoped access.

youtube_publish.policy: Direct GitHub OAuth remains an external auth gate. Metricool is a verified publish fallback only when the current brand still exposes YouTube and each publish returns a remote ID/URL/status read-back. Production/preflight alone is never publish proof.

metricool.evidence: Live connector brand settings exposed networksData.youtubeData and a public Short publish completed with remote video ID/URL/status read-back.

shopify_admin_api.scope_limit: Do not infer current write access, payment approval, or live storefront state from the old check.

youtube_analytics_api.reason: account OAuth is not currently usable; do not claim owned analytics from this path without a fresh successful read-back
